summary: John's maternal 4th great-grandfather; a pecoraio (shepherd) of Bisaccia.
bio:
Father of Angelamaria Fede; occupation pecoraio (shepherd), per Bisaccia Matrimoni 1867 act 17.

The FamilySearch tree gives Bartolomeo's birth as about 1811 in Bisaccia, his marriage to Nunzianna Roberto as 10 Jul 1835, and his parents as Giuseppe Fede (c.1758 – 12 Jan 1829) and Angela Maria Loffa (1780 – after 1835) ([R4-S1], [R4-S2]). Giuseppe's father was another Bartolomeo Fede, so the name ran in the family. Round 3 found Bartolomeo working as a pecoraio (shepherd) in 1867.
